title: Balancer — Deflationary Token Price Manipulation Analysis
loss_raw: ~$500,000 (WETH + WBTC + LINK + SNX mix across two pools)
root_cause: Pool balance discrepancy due to incompatibility with deflationary token (STA) that charges a transfer fee

Attacker
    │
    ├─[1] dYdX Flash Loan: Borrow large amount of WETH
    │
    ├─[2] Swap large amount WETH → STA (swapExactAmountIn)

    │       → STA price = effectively infinite
